findings.fix: Provide an intentional light variant or make dark mode feel fully resolved.

findings.name: Hosted on a vibe-builder deployment domain
findings.reason: No known vibe-builder deployment domain detected.
findings.fix: Move production sites to an owned domain and verify design provenance.

findings.name: Gradient hero headline text
findings.reason: The main headline 'ASIA'S LARGEST EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTION' and other headings use solid colors, not gradients.
findings.fix: Use plain display type or a more restrained brand treatment.

findings.name: Hero background is canvas-rendered or WebGL instead of CSS
findings.reason: The hero background is a static, subtle grid pattern, showing no visual signs of being rendered via Canvas/WebGL.
findings.fix: Use a CSS background or intentionally document the canvas/WebGL treatment.

findings.name: Interactive UI is rendered within a canvas layer
findings.reason: All visible UI elements appear to be standard HTML/CSS components, with no discernible parts rendered within a canvas layer.
findings.fix: Render interactive UI with DOM elements instead of placing it inside a canvas layer.

findings.name: Bento grid feature section
findings.reason: Sections like 'THE 4CS ROADMAP', 'ACADEMIC PROGRAMMES', and 'TECHNOLOGY & INNOVATION' display content in neatly aligned, distinct card-based grid layouts, characteristic of a bento grid.
findings.fix: Break the grid rhythm with content-led layout variation.

findings.name: Floating beta badge above hero
findings.reason: A light blue rectangular badge with 'SINCE 1979' is positioned centrally above the main hero heading.
findings.fix: Use context-specific launch/status copy or remove the badge.

findings.name: Dot/grid pattern overlay
findings.reason: No dot/grid overlay detected.
findings.fix: Replace decorative overlays with purposeful imagery or whitespace.

findings.name: Glow/halo CTA shadow
findings.reason: No CTA glow shadows detected.
findings.fix: Use normal elevation and hover states instead of default glow.

findings.name: Repeated section rhythm
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Vary section composition based on content priority.

findings.name: Inter or Geist as the only font
findings.reason: Typography is not Inter/Geist-only.
findings.fix: Add a deliberate display/body pairing or customize typography.

findings.name: Layout does not meaningfully change between 375px and 1440px viewport
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Ensure responsive breakpoints adapt layout across viewports.

findings.name: Site uses 8+ distinct computed colors with no token system
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Consolidate on a token palette and reduce redundant computed colors.

findings.name: No meta description, OG title, or OG image
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Add meta description and Open Graph metadata.

findings.name: Only font-weight 400 and 700 used
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Introduce intermediate font weights for typographic hierarchy.

findings.name: Heading sizes not on a modular scale
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Adjust headings to a consistent modular scale.

findings.name: No hover states on feature cards
findings.reason: Card hover absence not confirmed.
findings.fix: Add subtle hover feedback to interactive cards.

findings.name: Icons all same weight, size, and color
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Vary icon treatment where hierarchy requires it.

findings.name: Generic CTA copy
findings.reason: CTA copy is not strongly generic.
findings.fix: Replace generic CTAs with outcome-specific action text.

findings.name: No scroll-triggered entrance animations
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Add purposeful motion only where it clarifies hierarchy.

findings.name: Logo is just bold product name
findings.reason: Text-only logo not confirmed.
findings.fix: Add a distinctive mark, wordmark treatment, or custom lockup.

findings.name: Every heading is centered
findings.reason: Almost all major section headings across the page are consistently centered.
findings.fix: Mix left-aligned and centered sections based on content.

findings.name: Inconsistent spacing rhythm
findings.reason: Spacing rhythm does not look obviously broken.
findings.fix: Normalize spacing to an 8px rhythm or chosen spacing scale.

findings.name: No loading/skeleton states
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Design loading states for async areas.

findings.name: Dividers between every section
findings.reason: Divider overuse not detected.
findings.fix: Use whitespace and background shifts instead of constant borders.

findings.name: No cursor pointer on clickable cards
findings.reason: Clickable card cursor issue not detected.
findings.fix: Add cursor and focus/hover states to clickable cards.

findings.name: Grayscale low-opacity social proof logos
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Tune logo treatment so proof still feels credible.

findings.name: Footer has four identical link columns
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Shape footer navigation around real product priorities.

findings.name: Inline style values appear dynamically injected at runtime
findings.reason: No complex animations or advanced visual effects (gradients, blurs, highly dynamic opacities) are present that would visually necessitate dynamically injected inline styles; standard CSS hovers are observed.
findings.fix: Move repeated gradients, blur, or opacity decisions into stable CSS or document the runtime injection.

findings.name: No layered elevation system (all flat or one glow)
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Introduce layered elevation and subtle shadows for hierarchy.

findings.name: Internal card padding varies across similar cards
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Standardize card padding via tokens.

findings.name: Interactive elements use div/span instead of semantic tags
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Use semantic elements like button/nav/main/section.

findings.name: Computed stacking contexts use arbitrary magic numbers
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Refactor stacking contexts to use a scale or tokens.

findings.name: Animations without prefers-reduced-motion handling
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for nonessential animations.

findings.name: Images have no aspect-ratio set
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Set aspect-ratio or intrinsic size to avoid layout shift.

findings.name: Images match Unsplash/stock patterns
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Prefer original product/team/customer imagery.

findings.name: Contrast passes but is borderline and feels wrong
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Increase contrast and tune surface hierarchy.

findings.name: No focus states on inputs
findings.reason: 5/5 inputs lack visible focus indicators.
findings.fix: Add visible focus rings with accessible contrast.

findings.name: Placeholder disappears on focus
findings.reason: Most inputs rely on placeholders without persistent labels.
findings.fix: Use persistent labels or floating labels.

findings.name: Button has no active/pressed state
findings.reason: Button pressed-state feedback appears present.
findings.fix: Add :active scale, brightness, or pressed-state feedback.

findings.name: Body copy line-height too tight
findings.reason: Body line-height is not too tight.
findings.fix: Set body copy line-height around 1.6 to 1.75.

findings.name: Uppercase labels have zero letter spacing
findings.reason: Uppercase tracking issue not detected.
findings.fix: Add letter-spacing to uppercase labels.

findings.name: Reading width too wide or narrow
findings.reason: Paragraph widths look uncomfortable for reading.
findings.fix: Constrain paragraph measure to comfortable line lengths.

findings.name: No transition on theme/state changes
findings.reason: Interactive transitions are present.
findings.fix: Add transitions to interactive state changes.

findings.name: Nav has no active/current indicator
findings.reason: Navigation links have no obvious active/current state.
findings.fix: Add active state for the current route or section.

findings.name: Animations are linear
findings.reason: No linear animation timing detected.
findings.fix: Use a custom cubic-bezier easing curve.

findings.name: Scrollbar is browser default
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Style scrollbars when they are visible in the product surface.

findings.name: Selection color is browser default blue
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Add branded ::selection colors.

findings.name: No empty state design
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Design empty states for data-driven components.

findings.name: Tooltips use native title attribute
findings.reason: No native title tooltips detected.
findings.fix: Replace title-only tooltips with accessible custom tooltips.

findings.name: Font size does not scale on mobile
findings.reason: No fluid heading type tokens detected in computed snapshot.
findings.fix: Use responsive type tokens or clamp().

findings.name: Disabled states are just opacity
findings.reason: Weak disabled-state pattern not detected.
findings.fix: Define disabled color, cursor, and interaction behavior.

findings.name: Images have no meaningful alt text
findings.reason: Image alt text does not look broadly weak.
findings.fix: Write useful alt text or mark decorative images empty.

findings.name: Link underlines always on or off
findings.reason: Links appear uniformly underlined or uniformly plain.
findings.fix: Add a link hover/focus underline transition.

findings.name: No custom 404 page
findings.reason: Needs LLM or deeper product-specific inspection.
findings.fix: Add a branded 404 route.

findings.name: Paragraph lines too long
findings.reason: Some paragraph lines exceed comfortable reading width.
findings.fix: Constrain paragraph max-width.

findings.name: No favicon
findings.reason: Favicon present.
findings.fix: Add a real favicon and app icons.

findings.name: Modals do not trap focus

findings.name: No page transition between routes

findings.name: Border colors hardcoded hex values
